summary: USA Rare Earth, Inc. filed a routine Form 8-K on September 15, 2026, solely to supplement previously disclosed risk factors from its 2025 Form 10-K and subsequent 10-Qs, attaching the updated risk factors as Exhibit 99.1 under Items 8.01 and 9.01. No transaction, securities offering, board recommendation, advisor, price, stake, or closing terms are stated. The filing notes the pending April 19, 2026 SVRE Merger as background but discloses no new deal mechanics or regulatory clock. No special-situation event; no arbitrage angle, only routine disclosure monitoring.
